claim_1.claim: Illumina microarray analysis of PBMC from 24 BCG-primed healthy adults from the UK vaccinated with MVA85A at day 0, day 2 and day 7 post-vaccination, using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis and DAVID, showed that inflammatory response, positive regulation of the immune response, lysosome and apoptosis genes were enriched on day 2 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: Comparing two days after vaccination to baseline, 1100 genes were differentially expressed (false discovery rate <0.05). Heatmaps showing separation of individual volunteers using these genes is shown in Figure S2. Analysis of these genes using Gene Set Enrichment Analysis [31–33] (GSEA) and the Database for Annotation, Visualisation and Integrated Discovery [34] (DAVID) showed an enrichment for gene ontology (GO) terms and gene sets relating to an inflammatory response, positive regulation of the immune response, lysosome and apoptosis (Table 1).

claim_3.claim: Illumina microarray analysis of PBMC from 24 BCG-primed healthy adults from the UK vaccinated with MVA85A at day 0, day 2 and day 7 post-vaccination showed that CXCL10 (IP-10) had the greatest change in gene expression on day 2 compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: The greatest change in gene expression was seen in the interferon-induced chemokine CXCL10 (IP-10) with a fold change of 8.5 on day 2 compared to day 0.

claim_4.claim: Illumina microarray analysis of PBMC from 24 BCG-primed healthy adults from the UK vaccinated with MVA85A showed that CTLA4, CD5, IL2RΑ (CD25), TRAT1, STAT5B, CD28, CD3D, ITK, CD2 and DNAJA3 were more highly expressed on day 2 in low responders compared to high responders.

sources.quote: Two days after vaccination, 176 genes were differentially expressed between high and low responders. This list of genes was enriched for GO terms associated with regulation of T-cell activation and co-stimulation signal (DAVID, fdr<0.05). The genes contributing to the enrichment of these clusters, which are more highly expressed in low responders, are shown in table 2.
Table 2. Differentially expressed genes between high and low responders, two days after vaccination.

claim_5.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of unstimulated PBMC from high and low responders from day of vaccination (day 0) and 1 week later (day 7) showed that the CD4+ CD25+ Foxp3+ Treg population increased in low responders compared to baseline (day 0).

sources.quote: In high responders, the number of Tregs (as a percentage of CD4+ cells) remained constant pre- and post vaccination, however in low responders it increased between day 0 and day 7 (Figure 2a, p = 0.009).

Figure 2. Low responders make a stronger regulatory response to vaccination with MVA85A. To further explore the relationship between Treg markers and IFN-γ ELISpot response identified through the microarray, flow cytometry of Treg markers was done of cells from the same volunteers taken on day of vaccination (day 0) and 1 week later (day 7). - A. mRNA levels as measured by microarray for several Treg markers show an inverse correlation with the IFN-γ ELISpot response. B. The Treg population (CD4+ CD25+ Foxp3+) is increased in low but not high responders during the first week following vaccination (paired t-test, p=0.009) C. STAT5B expression on day 0 correlates with frequency of Tregs (CD25+ Foxp3+, % CD4+) and there is a trend between expression of CTLA4 on day 2 and Tregs on day 7.

claim_6.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of unstimulated PBMC from high and low responders from day of vaccination (day 0) and 1 week later (day 7) showed no increase in the CD4+ CD25+ Foxp3+ Treg population in high responders compared to baseline (day 0).

claim_17.claim: Western blot analysis of cell supernatants from MVA85A-stimulated cells at 4 and 6 hours showed that HMGB1 was released into the supernatant compared to unstimulated cells.

sources.quote: HMGB1 is detectable by western blot in the supernatant of infected cells 4 and 6 hours post infection but not in the supernatant of uninfected cells after 6 hours.
Figure 5. Toll-like receptors and HMGB1 in the innate response to MVA85A. C. Western blot showing HMGB1 is released into the supernatant of MVA85A stimulated but not unstimulated cells.

claim_20.claim: IFN-γ ELISpot analysis of splenocytes from mice vaccinated intradermally with MVA85A and culled 7 days later showed no significant difference in mean antigen 85A responses after co-administration of anti-TLR2 compared to MVA85A alone or MVA85A with isotype control.

sources.quote: Figure 5. Toll-like receptors and HMGB1 in the innate response to MVA85A. D. Mixing anti-TLR2 to MVA85A when vaccinating mice reduces the spread of responses (F-test, p<0.05) but not the mean (student’s t-test, p=0.18 MVA vs anti-TLR2, p=0.12 MVA85A vs isotype control).
